Your open questions: How close are the library pigment colours and Kubelka-Munk constants (scattering by transparency, tinting strength) to real paints? They are estimated, not measured, and mixing is done per RGB channel rather than over the full spectrum. (unk_d84de3eac895864f); Which pigment code did the artist mean for "Crimson PG__" (PG is a green pigment code; crimsons are usually PR)? I used PR206 for the Crimson example. (unk_922d89198328d553).
